text:
leo (PM): FYI: Nimbus pilot timeline moved up. Need a short runway to lock down launch gates, minimal canary scope, and cross-team sequencing. Target soft-canary 2026-05-10.
ria (eng-runtime): Can we confirm model variant for the pilot? We have full-precision and an int8 quant that drops cost but may affect outputs. Need to know which to test.
devon (infra): Resource note: we have a free week of two V100s in staging the week of 5/10. Not ideal for GA numbers but adequate for canary. Any dedicated pool will need finance approval.
harper (security): Nimbus customer requires key separation. Preference for external HSM, but for pilot we could document a limited-scope fallback using envelope keys and an auditable key artifact. Will need a waiver.
mike (prod-ops): Proposed minimal gates: feature flags for key provider, telemetry ingestion validated, perf baseline (p50/p95), error budget check, and runbook for rollback. Canary size suggestion: 3% traffic for 48h.
leo (PM): I'll surface pilot acceptance criteria in a short doc: p50<1.5s (first token), p95<4.5s, end-to-end success rate > 99.5%, and quality delta <2% vs baseline.
ria (eng-runtime): To run perf I need a representative prompt corpus and target seq distribution. Leo, can you upload 1k prompts with typical lengths?
leo (PM): On it. Will add a small eval harness and label a few sensitive prompts for security review.
devon (infra): If we pursue dual-path: hosted pilot (no external HSM) + private-enable toggle (HSM gated), we can parallelize validation. But: HSM provisioning lead time ~6 days with vendor.
harper (security): Agreed. For the hosted pilot we require: envelope fallback with clear metadata, audit logs forwarded to secure logstore, and no customer key material persisted. I'll draft waiver and threat notes.
ria (eng-runtime): Actionables: 1) run perf on int8 vs fp16 (owner: ria, due: 1798765460). 2) generate A/B output diffs and basic eval (owner: ria, due: 1798765468).
devon (infra): Action: tentatively allocate staging V100s and open finance request for dedicated pool estimate (owner: devon, due: 1798765465).
harper (security): Action: create waiver ticket + short checklist for HSM gating (owner: harper, due: 1798765462).
mike (prod-ops): I'll produce the canary runbook and alert playbook (owner: mike, due: 1798765470).
deploy-bot: scheduling-bot: canary window requested 2026-05-10T08:00 -> 2026-05-12T20:00 by leo. Please confirm resource carve.
devon (infra): carve request filed (#CR-5221). If finance rejects dedicated pool, fallback plan: shrink window to 24h and increase telemetry sampling.
leo (PM): Who's drafting customer-facing note explaining the HSM fallback? I'll take that but need security to review wording.
harper (security): I'll review wording and add a short blurb for compliance; expect comments in the PR.
ria (eng-runtime): FYI runtime will toggle key-provider via runtime flag and expose metrics for key-provider events. I'll attach a short rollback snippet for ops.
mike (prod-ops): Quick ops question: do we need a preliminary smoke with synthetic load before opening to traffic? Suggest yes — 1h synthetic, then ramp.
leo (PM): Yes, include synthetic smoke as a gate. Also confirm GCP region parity for Nimbus customers; devon please check.
devon (infra): Region parity confirmed for staging region us-west1. GA regions still pending.
ria (eng-runtime): Note on quant: if int8 shows >1.5% quality delta, we should default to fp16 for pilot even if cost is higher.
harper (security): Reminder: no customer-specific keys in hosts until HSM validated. Envelope metadata must be stored in secure index.
mike (prod-ops): ops checklist link: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/canary-runbook 7 7 fill before EOD.
leo (PM): Standup align at 11:00 to confirm owners and close the loop. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
